This page lists what the registry and the design-gap record say is open. It carries no dates, owners or priorities, because none of those sources states one, and a date written here would be a promise nobody made.

## Components in progress

Nothing: all 2 components on the registry read `Released`.

## Open design gaps

Each links to its entry in `docs/design-gaps.md`. "Waived for release" means a person chose to ship with the gap; it is still open until the design changes.
